# Browser contracts for the CI job `contracts` (hacs M45/D12), run by .github/workflows/validate.yml with
# --network none in the pinned Playwright image. Only repo scripts without private data and without network.
# One script per line, relative to the repo root; {bundle} = dist/<bundle>.js, {out} = a fresh output folder.
# compact-contract.py runs its synthetic part only; its editor part needs the native HA frontend.
# Not listed: render.py (needs hacs/docs/render/regeln.py) and visual-contract.py (needs the output of render.py),
# live-ha-native.py (running HA, private access file). The editor contract is node --test tests/editor.test.js.
docs/render/compact-contract.py {bundle} {out}
